# Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan

**1. Sticky header**
Slim forest-green (#1B3A2F) bar. Tidepool wordmark in a soft serif; nav links (Product, Teams, Pricing) in white humanist sans; coral (#FF6F5E) pill button "Start your week."

**2. Hero — split layout**
Left sidebar (~280px): vertical week timeline, Mon–Sun as nodes on a hand-drawn dotted line, current day a filled coral circle. It anchors the page's identity and doubles as scroll progress — sections below light up each day.
Right column: single-sentence conversational headline, white serif, 44–56px: *"Give your small team one shared view of the week that fills itself in as plans change, remembers what you committed to last Monday, and quietly makes Friday's retro take ten minutes instead of an hour."*
Subhead + coral CTA beneath. A rough hand-drawn coral arrow curves from the headline's last line to the main visual: a screenshot of Tidepool's weekly board with three avatars dragging tasks between days.

**3. Monospace pull quote**
Full-width pale-kelp (#EAF2ED) band. Quote in 20px monospace, coral opening quotation mark: *"We stopped having the Monday meeting. The week just… shows up."* — attribution in small caps.

**4. Three alternating feature rows**
Each row: illustration/screenshot left or right, text opposite. Themes mirror the timeline: **Plan** (Monday ritual), **Adapt** (live updates when things slip), **Reflect** (Friday recap). Coral accents on headings only.

**5. Week-in-practice strip**
Horizontal Mon–Fri cards showing a sample team's board evolving — imagery, not copy-heavy.

**6. Logo bar + second monospace micro-quote**
Grayscale customer logos on white; one-line quote beneath.

**7. Closing CTA band**
Deep green, centered: "Your next week starts here." Coral button; the week-timeline motif repeats faintly as background texture.

**8. Footer**
White, minimal: product links, socials, fine print in muted green-gray.
final:
# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

Key upgrades: the timeline becomes the page's narrative spine (scrolling = moving through the week), redundant sections are cut, and every copy moment gets a concrete line.

**1. Sticky header**
Slim deep-forest (#1B3A2F) bar. Wordmark in soft serif; only two anchor links that resolve on-page ("How it works," "Customers") in white humanist sans; coral (#FF6F5E) pill: "Start your week."

**2. Hero**
Left: ~280px sidebar timeline, Mon–Sun nodes on a hand-drawn dotted line, today's node filled coral. Now the spine: each section below fills its node as you scroll; visited nodes stay softly filled, like completed days.
Right: single winding headline in white serif, 48–56px, mirroring the reference's cadence but landing on a concrete payoff: *"Gather your small team around one living view of the week that updates the moment plans shift, remembers what each of you promised last Monday, and settles Friday's 'so what actually got done?' before anyone has to ask."* Subhead + coral CTA beneath. Hand-drawn coral arrow curves from the final clause to the hero screenshot — the weekly board mid-drag, three avatars, one task drifting Thursday→Friday with a "moved by Priya" tag, on a subtle loop. The page itself lives.

**3. Monospace pull quote**
Full-width pale-kelp (#EAF2ED) band, oversized coral quote mark, 20px mono: *"We cancelled our Monday standup in week two. Nobody has missed it."* Attribution in small caps: "Dana O., Head of Ops, 9-person studio." Specific numbers make it credible.

**4. Three day-chapters** *(How it works)*
Features become the week, each pinned to a node. **MON · Plan** — "Monday takes ten minutes": tasks dragged onto days, avatars claiming them. **WED · Adapt** — "When reality moves, the week moves": a slipped task flags coral, pings its owner, board re-flows. **FRI · Reflect** — "Friday writes its own recap": auto-built digest card. Coral reserved for day-labels only.

**5. Customers band**
White; five grayscale logos; one stat line: "Built for teams of 3–15." *(Cut the earlier week-strip and second quote — they duplicated sections 3–4.)*

**6. Closing CTA**
Deep green, faint timeline motif as texture. Serif: *"Your next week starts Monday."* Coral button "Claim your first week," microcopy: "Free up to 5 people. No card."

**7. Footer**
Off-white, three slim link columns, fine print in muted green-gray.
